digest.component_or_area: dev bootstrap and metrics analyzer installation
propositions: Makefile install and install-unlocked must explicitly name the metrics extra to pin the toolchain intent independently of CI rationale, ensuring future dev venvs retain analyzers even if the dev self-reference is trimmed
Python analyzer lizard (1.23.0) already arrives transitively via the dev extra's self-reference to nava-rebar[agents,metrics], so the Makefile change is hardening rather than a fix
Non-Python analyzers scc (Go) and jscpd (Node) require documented manual install steps (brew install scc and npm install -g jscpd) as they cannot come from a Python extra
With scc and jscpd absent from PATH, rebar metrics must degrade to Unavailable rather than fail hard, leaving make lint, make typecheck, and the test suite unaffected
docs/local-dev-env.md must document both scc and jscpd as optional tools with explicit commands, explaining that their absence only downgrades specific metrics lenses to Unavailable
